environment: macOS arm64; Rust 1.81.0; original shell scripts run in a PTY with the Rust release binary first in PATH
focused_command: PATH="$PWD/target/release:$PWD/test/tools:$PATH" TEST_OPTS="verbose no-indent" GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=init.defaultBranch GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=master sh test/tigrc/<script>
quote_baseline_comparison: A separately built unmodified e94a87b main produced a byte-for-byte identical quote-test receipt. The final release after merging PR #1 at base_revision was compared against that historical receipt; the same 6 failures remain. Unmodified base_revision was not rebuilt for a new differential comparison.
scope: Configuration-file warning prefix, original diagnostic paths, per-file direct-error summaries, invalid global enum fallback, malformed quoted bindings, continuation line numbers and EOF. Prompt words/apply_command errors remain strict and atomic.
remaining: Full configuration parity is not claimed. Column enum fallback/obsolete date modes and other non-bind quotation semantics are outside this slice. quote-test command-variable expansion remains failing. view-column-test, compat-error-test, append-option-test, builtin-error-test and other tigrc scripts may benefit from the shared diagnostics changes but were not rerun.

review_followup.missing_source: File does not exist retains the source argument including ~; the file summary still uses its expanded path. Regression covers source -q as well.
review_followup.enum_order: For global enums, C option_update first parses/stores the value and reports excess arguments only after successful parsing. Both jada extra (fallback warning, no) and all extra (arity warning, all) have state/diagnostic regressions; prompt errors remain atomic.
review_followup.date_boundary: Column date-display does not enter option_type/global enum recovery. local/short are regression-checked to leave state unchanged; full C obsolete date-mode recovery remains outside scope.
review_followup.quoted_binding: Unfinished quoted arguments preserve original bytes instead of losing quote characters. Actual App.binding -> App.action tests cover both quote kinds and assert unchanged configuration. Existing valid quoted shell-command assertions still pass.

main_integration_command: PATH="$PWD/target/release:$PWD/test/tools:$PATH" TEST_OPTS="verbose no-indent" GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=init.defaultBranch GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=master sh test/diff/<script>
main_integration: Merged origin/main 47f1a2b2 without conflicts; preserved both configuration diagnostics and the new shared diff switches. Reran all Rust checks, five configuration scripts and both merged diff-context scripts; no new focused failures. Original diff screen assertions use the harness default whitespace-insensitive comparison.
